instructions: Review every changed file in depth and report all real problems, including smaller ones, with the concrete failure scenario (inputs or state -> wrong result or crash) and a suggested fix. Priorities for this repo: (1) crashes and hangs on the iPhone app: SwiftUI List/ForEach identity and batch-update consistency, main-actor isolation, force unwraps, sheet/fullScreenCover state races, loading states that can spin forever; (2) Lea's honesty rules: never claim an uninspected part is fine, never invent defects or numbers, never speak internal ids; (3) nothing hard-coded to one product (Xbox, Arduino): logic must work for any object; (4) stale caches keyed without input revisions; (5) every paid API call goes through the spend guard; (6) no secrets, tokens or API keys on the phone or in the repo; (7) geometry/registration code that can silently accept a wrong pose. Also note performance problems on the phone (SceneKit frame cost, blur over the camera) and missing tests for new behaviour.
